title: Bend a sine — Keep a positive opening while the source runs half once or twice
help: All three waves start the source at its positive peak with steady index two. Half-speed, equal-speed and double-speed sources share that opening sample, but do not keep the same shape. The finite envelope stays unchanged. Choosing is silent; Play is separate.
message: phases experiments keep the supplied choices silent and reversible
facts: Rows[id,label,ratio,phaseInTurns,index] produce {ratio,phase,index,bend:"steady",moment:0}. ratio.5/1/2 are existing native options. Phase.25 is a quarter TURN. At plotted t0 source=sin(π/2)=1, frozen bent sample=sin(2)=.9092974268256817 for all three. Half source needs two carrier cycles to repeat; equal and double repeat after one. Existing model stays unchanged.
